contractCompliance: Accepted shared/personal-office entities remain read-only and authoritative.
Registry records compose SkillPackage and ToolDefinition instead of redefining domain entities.
IntegrationGrant and RuntimeInstance remain accepted domain concepts and cannot be minted by manifests.
Loop 03 WorkService remains the authority for approval hashing, redaction, persistence and decisions.
Package manifests, package files and lockfiles remain unchanged.

securityGate.surface: untrusted .ocx/.oab declarations, permissions, classifications, secrets and side effects
controls: Strict exact-key, versioned plain-object envelope parser.
Manifest declares keys only; trusted policy supplies permission, trust zone, classification, effects, risk and status.
Unknown, wildcard, duplicate, blocked and unsupported declarations fail closed.
Credential-shaped public metadata is rejected; publisher digest has an exact sha256 format.
Network egress is limited to public_metadata.
Invocation requires an exact permission; wildcard grants do not satisfy it.
Capability fingerprints and whole-registry digest are verified before authorization.
Audit verification re-derives supported versions, object relationships and every authority-bearing field from the trusted policy catalog; recomputed public hashes cannot mint authority.
Invocation accepts no caller-owned grantedPermissions. A trusted resolver must return an accepted IntegrationGrant bound exactly to tenant, user, workspace, package, capability and permission.
Capability, policy and registry identity is embedded in Loop 03 hashed input and estimated-side-effect fields.
Managed services allow only the host-controlled Docker Compose launch form and package-bound backend URL environment variables.
Side effects become Loop 03 approval inputs and are never executed by the adapter.
